beats.subline: Monday, August 31, 2026 close — a modest pullback as the Iran conflict flared anew, though August still closed with solid gains.
beats.body: Oil prices jumped after the US and Iran traded strikes over the weekend for the first time in weeks, reviving inflation worries just as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned price pressures remain too hot; even so, all three indexes closed August with solid monthly gains — the S&P 500 +2.5%, Nasdaq +3%, and the Dow +1.3%.

beats.headline: Pentagon corrects Trump's false claim of a strike on Iran's Kharg Island oil hub
beats.body: President Trump posted an AI-generated video Sunday night depicting Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal being "blown to smithereens," but a US official said Monday no such strike occurred and Iran's state oil company called the claim laughable, days after Washington and Tehran resumed exchanging fire for the first time in weeks.

beats.headline: Xi Jinping tours Kyrgyzstan and heads to India as he builds leverage ahead of Trump summit
beats.body: Xi arrived in Bishkek for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit Tuesday and plans his first trip to India since the 2020 border clashes for the BRICS summit Sept. 12-13, a diplomatic push Washington has watched warily since a viral Xi-Modi-Putin moment last year prompted Trump to say the US had "lost India and Russia to deepest, darkest China"; AI security is shaping up as a key topic for the Trump-Xi summit expected later this month.

beats.headline: Iran fires missiles at US-linked bases in Jordan after US strike on Hormuz launch sites
beats.body: Iran's IRGC said it launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on Jordan's King Hussein and Al Azraq air bases, which host US forces, in retaliation for a US strike on Iranian missile launchers on Larak Island; Jordan's military said it intercepted eight incoming missiles, and the IRGC separately said it struck US positions at an air base in the UAE hours later.

beats.headline: Pentagon adds ChatGPT and Grok to its GenAI.mil platform, leaving Claude out again
beats.body: The Defense Department rolled out custom "ChatGPT Mil" and "Grok for Government" tools on its 3-million-user GenAI.mil portal alongside Google's Gemini, but Anthropic's Claude was again left off the list, months after a federal judge ruled the Pentagon had illegally blacklisted Anthropic amid its refusal to loosen Claude's usage restrictions on mass surveillance and autonomous weapons.

beats.headline: Bears WR Luther Burden trending toward Week 1 return after groin injury
beats.body: Coach Ben Johnson said Burden, who missed the entire preseason after injuring his groin in training camp, "looks 100% to me" in practice, a strong signal the second-year receiver will be available when Chicago opens the season Sept. 13 at Carolina.
